body:
Thanks @iapparatus for opening this issue. Even though, we haven't implemented that yet, [we have it in mind](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/2130).

In the meantime, I suggest you create your own menu widget widget using the [connectMenu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectMenu.html). Using it you can inject the static list of values that you want.
